tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me
tool_schemas.description: Registers a new ntfy-me server instance and its topic subscriptions, returning the created server record and the created subscription records. Validates that `server.display_name` and `server.base_url` are provided, that any provided `server.status` is one of `provisioning|active|paused|degraded|deleted`, and that each subscription includes a `topic` and any provided subscription `status` is one of `active|paused|deleted`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed or missing required fields, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create deployments, and CONFLICT if the server or a subscription for the same topic already exists for this deployment.

server.description: Server instance to create/register for this ntfy-me-mcp deployment.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for the server instance.

base_url.description: Base URL of the upstream ntfy server (e.g., https://ntfy.sh).

default_fetch_limit.description: Default maximum number of messages to fetch per retrieval/ingest cycle.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the server instance.

subscriptions.description: List of topic subscriptions to create for the server instance.

topic.description: ntfy topic name to subscribe to.

since_event_id.description: Upstream event id to resume ingestion from (if known).

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_fetch
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached notifications for the specified server instance as a paged list, honoring `limit` (or the server’s configured default) and `cursor` to continue from a prior page; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `server_id` does not match `^ntfy_srv_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$`, if `limit` is not a positive integer, or if `cursor` is invalid for the requested server. Raises NOT_FOUND if `server_id` does not exist (or has been deleted), FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read that server’s cache, and CONFLICT if the server is not in a readable state (for example, still provisioning).

server_id.description: ID of the ntfy-me server instance whose cached messages should be fetched.

limit.description: Maximum number of cached messages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for continuing a previous fetch.

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_servers_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists registered ntfy-me server instances visible to the caller, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and paged with limit/cursor; returns server records and a next cursor when more results are available, and refuses invalid status values or cursors.

status.description: If provided, only return servers in this lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior list response.

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_servers_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single ntfy-me server instance by id; returns the server record if found and visible to the caller, or refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist/ is not accessible and VALIDATION_ERROR if the id format is invalid.

server_id.description: ID of the ntfy-me server instance to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_servers_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing ntfy-me server instance and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions via `status`; returns the updated server record and refuses invalid transitions (e.g., deleted is terminal) or invalid field values.

server_id.description: ID of the ntfy-me server instance to update.

display_name.description: New human-friendly name for the server instance.

base_url.description: New base URL of the upstream ntfy server.

default_fetch_limit.description: New default maximum number of messages to fetch per retrieval/ingest cycle.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the server instance; must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_subscriptions_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists topic subscriptions for a given server instance, optionally filtered by subscription status and paged with limit/cursor; returns subscription records and a next cursor when more results are available, and refuses invalid status values or cursors.

server_id.description: ID of the server whose subscriptions should be listed.

status.description: If provided, only return subscriptions in this status.

limit.description: Maximum number of subscriptions to return (default 100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior list response.

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_subscriptions_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates one or more topic subscriptions for an existing server instance; returns the created subscription records and refuses creation for deleted servers or activation when the parent server is paused/deleted (activation is only allowed when the server is active or degraded).

server_id.description: ID of the server to add subscriptions to.

subscriptions.description: Subscriptions to create for the server.

topic.description: ntfy topic name to subscribe to.

since_event_id.description: Upstream event id to resume ingestion from (if known).

dedupe_key.description: Optional idempotency key for this subscription create to prevent duplicates for repeated calls.

tool_schemas.name: ntfy_me_subscriptions_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a topic subscription’s mutable fields and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions via `status`; returns the updated subscription record and refuses invalid transitions or attempts to activate a subscription when the parent server is paused or deleted.

subscription_id.description: ID of the topic subscription to update.

topic.description: New ntfy topic name (if supported by the deployment).

status.description: New lifecycle status for the subscription; must be a valid transition from the current status.

since_event_id.description: Upstream event id to resume ingestion from (if known).

metadata.name: ntfy-me-mcp
